The App-shaped HTTP API an App can opt into. Every key here is stable ([status](/docs/status/)). [All parts](/docs/app-dsl/).

## `api`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api` | apiRead | Stable | Exposure metadata; it opens no routes by itself. Commands must be targeted and are served only beside their --commands registry. Runtime checks logical catalog, roles, the command registry and authority lock. |

## `api.commands`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.commands` | array | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |

## `api.commands[]`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.commands[].command` | string | Stable | A command, by its name in the App's commands module (defineCommands). The server fills in its input, target and version from the registration; mistri-commands.d.ts types the names. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `api.commands[].description` | string | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `api.commands[].label` | string | Stable |  |

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |

## `api.events`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.events` | array | Stable | Command events the event feed serves, each its own token operation (event:&lt;name>). |

## `api.network`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.network` | boolean | Stable | Let the API and its MCP endpoint answer beyond loopback when the server listens there (--host, --allowed-host, --trust-proxy). Absent, they answer loopback only and a wider listener refuses to start. Recorded in authority.lock. |

## `api.publicSpec`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.publicSpec` | boolean | Stable | Serve the OpenAPI document at …/$openapi without a token: every operation the API declares, without its roles or standing queries. Absent or false, the document is a token's own, narrowed to what it may do. |
